---
title: "Putting it together"
order: 4
---

A course page often combines several content elements to guide participants through a topic. This example brings together headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, and callouts in one structured page.

Use it as a starting point for your own course material. Replace the demonstration text with information relevant to your course, and remove any elements you do not need.

## Example: Introducing a course topic

### Overview

In this section, introduce the topic and explain why it is relevant to participants.

Clear introductory text helps participants understand what they will learn and how the topic connects to the course.

### Learning objectives

By the end of this section, participants will be able to:

- Describe the main concept introduced in the section.
- Identify key information related to the topic.
- Apply the concept in a practical context.

### Key information

Use a table when participants need to compare or quickly find specific information.

| Topic element | Example content |
|---|---|
| Main concept | Introduce the central idea |
| Key information | Explain the most important points |
| Practical application | Show how the concept can be used |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tip

Use callouts to highlight information that participants should notice. Keep the message focused, and avoid using callouts for information that belongs in the main text.
:::

### Activity

Give participants an opportunity to apply what they have learned.

**Instructions**

1. Read the example or scenario.
2. Discuss the questions with a partner or group.
3. Identify the main points from the discussion.
4. Share your conclusions.

### Reflection

Ask participants to consider how the topic relates to their own work or experience.

- What is one important idea you learned?
- How could you apply it in your own context?
- What would you like to explore further?

## The source Markdown

The example above can be created using the following Quarto Markdown structure. Copy it into a `.qmd` file and adapt the content.

